theme_and_concept.description: A clean, modern, and highly legible dashboard designed for a government/educational institution. It focuses on clarity, trust, and usability without feeling 'stuffy' or outdated. It leverages generous whitespace, a distinct serif for authority mixed with a geometric sans for functional UI, and subtle architectural/monumental visual motifs.

headings.usage: Use strictly for the main institution name (e.g., 'Centre of Higher Education, Haryana') and major page titles.

body_and_ui.usage: Use for all functional elements, cards, navigation, forms, and hierarchy details. Provides a clean, highly legible modern feel.

guidelines: Ensure all UI labels and secondary text use Manrope with tracking-tight or tracking-wide where appropriate.
Never center-align paragraphs; maintain strong left alignment for data.
The jump between a heading and its subheading must not exceed 2 Tailwind steps.
typography.installation: Ensure to add Google Fonts for Playfair Display and Manrope in the index.html or global css.

primary.description: Deep Slate/Navy for authority and high contrast. Use for top nav, primary buttons, and main text.

accent.description: Subtle Gold/Amber for active states, highlights, and subtle institutional prestige without being overwhelming.

login_page.structure: Split layout or centered floating card over a monumental architectural background.
login_page.overlay: A crisp white/glass panel for the login form, ensuring absolute contrast for inputs.

dashboard.navigation: Top navigation bar (Solid white or glass) with left-aligned Playfair Display Logo/Title, and right-aligned admin profile/logout.
dashboard.content_area: Max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8.
dashboard.search_bar: Prominent, large input field at the top of the dashboard for filtering branches. Should be clean with a subtle search icon.
dashboard.grid: Bento-style or neat uniform grid (grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6) for the 33 branch cards.

branch_hierarchy_page.header: Back button + Branch Title + subtle stats/description.
branch_hierarchy_page.tree_structure: A vertical organizational tree structure. Use overlapping layout or connected nodes (via CSS border lines) representing Assistant Director -> Superintendent -> Assistant -> Clerk -> DEO.
branch_hierarchy_page.node_design: Each node should be a clean card displaying Name (bold), Role (badge/subtext), and a subtle avatar or icon.

BranchCard.description: A clickable card representing a department.
BranchCard.styling: White background, 1px border-slate-200, subtle hover lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-lg. Include a Lucide icon related to the branch (or a generic building/folder icon), branch name, and a small 'View Hierarchy' arrow.

OrgNode.description: Component for a single person in the hierarchy.
OrgNode.styling: Rectangle card. Left side: Avatar/Initials placeholder. Right side: Name in primary text, Role in muted text. A vertical line should connect the bottom of one node to the top of the next to show hierarchy.

motion.hover: Transition transform and shadow on cards (duration 200ms ease-out).
motion.page_transition: Simple fade-in or slide-up using Framer Motion for entering the dashboard and hierarchy pages.
motion.list_stagger: Staggered fade-up for branch cards on load.

media.icons: lucide-react (Landmark, Users, Search, ArrowLeft, LogOut, ChevronRight)

images.description: Clean, modern monumental white pillars. Use as full-screen background with a white overlay on the login page.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install lucide-react, framer-motion, and set up Shadcn components (card, input, button, avatar, badge, dropdown-menu).
Add 'Playfair Display' and 'Manrope' to your fonts (e.g. Google Fonts link in index.html). Set tailwind.config.js to use them.
Do not use generic blue/purple gradients. Stick strictly to the Slate/Navy, White, and Gold color palette.
For the login page, use the provided Unsplash image as a background with a heavy white or glassmorphism overlay on the side where the form sits.
Implement routing for Login -> Dashboard -> Branch Hierarchy (e.g. /login, /dashboard, /branch/:id).
Generate mock data for 33 branches (e.g., Sports, Academics, Finance, Examinations, Admissions, HR, IT, Library, Research, etc.).
Implement the search filter for the branch cards on the dashboard.

On the Branch Hierarchy page, construct the vertical tree layout carefully with CSS. The structure is fixed: Assistant Director -> Superintendent -> Assistant -> Clerk -> DEO. Mock the names as requested: Deepak sir, Dhoop singh, Anita Dhiman, Ishwar, Vijay.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic 'AI slop' aesthetics.
Do not use universal transitions (transition: all).
Do not center-align the app container. Respect natural reading flow.
Never use placeholder image services like via.placeholder.com. Use Unsplash images or pure UI.
Apply 2-3x more spacing than typical defaults.
Add proper z-index and layering to components.
